releaseName: Self-hosted data protected, API edge hardened
summary: One sprint since server-v0.15.0 (milestone 70). A clone's pnpm self-hosted stack now runs as its own Compose project, draft-loop-dev, on port 8081, so branch code and its migrations never reach an installed stack's data (#2169). The server threat model's four gaps are closed: security headers are pinned by tests (#2144); the API limits requests per source address, with a much smaller budget for refused credentials, and answers 429 rate_limited (#2145); draft-loop-server token --rotate replaces the owner token, and the guides give the procedure (#2146); and the desktop client hands a remembered token only to a server that proves it holds it through POST /v1/auth/proof (#2148, #2172, #2173). draftloop-mcp init names the intake switch only when it is off (#2170).
knownLimitations: Request limits are counted per API instance and, on a self-hosted stack, shared by every client on 127.0.0.1, so a misconfigured agent can lock the others out for a minute. The desktop part of #2148 reaches people with the next desktop release. The work journal and agent tokens are still served in owner-token mode only (#2079).
